summary: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that it made an updated investor presentation available on its website as of September 16, 2026, attached as Exhibit 99.1. The filing is a routine disclosure of investor materials and expressly states it is not an admission as to materiality and carries no obligation to update. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are stated. No special-situation event is present; monitor for any future operational updates.
